title: Law to help homeowners facing displacement find assistance
summary: This bill would require HPD's Homeowner Advocate, working with other city agencies, to create an outreach and education program for homeowners at risk of displacement. HPD would have to identify which community districts face the greatest displacement risk each year, considering factors like eviction and foreclosure rates, and target outreach materials and events there. The program must launch within 180 days of the law taking effect.
